## Project identity
**Descriptive name:** **Arabic RTL Ministry Website Reconstruction / Front-End Integration Prototype**

A static Arabic/RTL front-end reconstruction for the Life in Christ ministry site, combining Bootstrap navigation, responsive article cards, modals, donation/external-form links, language switching and existing organization branding/content URLs. The implementation demonstrates RTL/responsive composition and integration work, but it must be attributed carefully: organization copy, imagery, branding and upstream website content are not independent authored product content. It is also largely hardcoded, with no CMS/backend synchronization.
